submission.justification: Module-D2 at 30% coverage gave the highest simulated light collection, 52.3 PE/MeV. Module-D3 at 30% gave 37.6 PE/MeV. The 2025 study at 20% coverage ranked the designs the same way (D2 38, D3 27, D1 18). I didn't simulate D1 at 30%. Feedthroughs are sufficient for 30% coverage. The cold amplifiers are validated for all designs. One caveat: D2 uses a thin bonded dichroic filter, and no project document has cryogenic robustness or lifetime data for it. Because modules can't be accessed once the cryostat is filled, I recommend a cryogenic thermal-cycling and bond-integrity test before the Q3 design freeze. D3 is the fallback if that test fails.
